cap: The fetal head follows six cardinal movements, from engagement to expulsion. When the anterior shoulder catches, a hard pull on the head stretches the upper trunk (C5 and C6) and causes Erb palsy, whereas an arm pulled above the head injures the lower trunk (C8 and T1) in Klumpke palsy, sometimes with Horner syndrome. Perineal tears are graded by the deepest structure torn.
